title: Construction of an executable binary field model
statement: For $\ell>0$, construct an executable binary field model by choosing a certified irreducible binary modulus of degree $\ell$, listing all length-$\ell$ binary vectors as the field elements, and assembling their binary addition and modular multiplication tables using that modulus.
caveat: The construction of the certified implementation and the definitions of the vector enumeration and modular multiplication are omitted, so their precise choices are not visible here.
